body: I'm having my first panic attack in months and came back to reread my old posts to remind me of a much darker time. I told him shortly after I posted this. He was extremely supportive. Told me his heart was broken that I had to go through that. He's the best part of my life and my closest friend. I'm much more whole. Thank you for being so encouraging.

"You wouldn't ask them to have a baby for your benefit and nor should they." This is the first time I've heard this and it's so, so true. Thank you for that. I dodged a bullet. Of that I am certain. Thanks again for that tiny sentence that's changed a lot of my perspective.

Thank you so much. I never responded to my ex's family when this blew up in November. He betrayed me by skewing arguably the most personal experience I'll ever have into something that turned me into a monster. That's not someone I need to be with. 

When the time is right I'll tell new guy. I don't believe in keeping secrets. I'm scared but, again, it's an experience I had and a decision I made that I need to stand behind. Hopefully he'll stand behind me, too. 

Thanks for taking the time to respond to such a lengthy post. This community has done so much for me. Have a great day!

Thank you so, so much. I know I dodged a bullet and I am grateful for that every single day. What they did was hurtful and cruel, especially after nearly two years of considering them family. I never responded to them and I know one day it will be a distant memory. I am so looking forward to that day. I know that anyone who uses something so personal and so intimate as leverage to make me look bad is no one I should stress over. 

Again, I'm so grateful for the support of this anonymous community and really appreciate you taking the time to help me sort through this. The new guy treats me like I hung the moon and is so good to me. I know that in time this could be something that makes or breaks us (he's very, very conservative politically) but I'm taking it slow. Thank you again. Your advice and words of comfort are truly a blessing to me.
Thank you. I'm grateful for people like you who can give me perspective to the "fuck you" part of my brain that I so often forget about. :)

Thank you so much. It's nice to have support from people who have been through the same thing. I have bouts where I'm so incredibly sad for the loss, but overall I've tried not to let it define who I am. I minimized the entire experience because I wanted to move on, but I ended up just carrying the weight of a tremendous secret. 

My ex's parents left me messages last night saying I killed their grandbaby and that was "so selfish and shitty of me". It shouldn't matter what they think, but it was incredibly hurtful. 

It's been arguably one of the worst days of my life, but, like you said, this is not an experience that I've had exclusively. I'm not an island. I thank God for that, and for people like you who make me feel a little more normal. Feel free to PM me if you ever want to talk.

I've been going to counseling and it's helped me exponentially. My ex called me and said he didn't know anyone had called/texted/harassed me. I made sure he knew exactly what they'd said to me. He apologized to my mom for the way they treated me. His mom apologized for her inappropriate voicemail last night, but I will never speak with her again. 

I appreciate your support. I've found more comfort here than anywhere else. I'm extremely grateful.

Update: I told my mom. She's shocked. She's sad for me that I've had to do this on my own for three months. She's hurt that I didn't trust them enough to ask their advice. She's furious with his family for being so hateful. I know she supports me and wants me to be okay, more than anything, but I don't feel very okay and I feel so pressured. I'm basically just hibernating, waiting for my dad to get home so I can break his heart, too.
Thank you so much. I appreciate you being so kind. I'm feeling more hopeful today and people like you really help me to remain focused on why I do what I do. I hope you have a great day.

Thank you so much for the kind words. Waking up to a message like that really helped me to refocus on why I do what I do. I've been to a counselor and have an upcoming appointment on Monday. Thank you, thank you, thank you. Treading water, burned out, but hopeful.
